phase_order: round0 warmup:0..8; formal odd rounds:8..0; formal even rounds:0..8. Six formal forward and six reverse blocks; every legacy/balanced pair is measured in both orders six times.
outputs: shared modes slot=provider; distinct modes slot=step; four stable physical MTLBuffers
common_snapshot: CPU memcpy full scores and guards immediately after each GPU wait, all modes. No validation sampling. Every CB raw saved, hardlinks only after complete SHA identity.
inline_validation: two complete word comparisons, finite/poison/causal scan and SHA between CBs; record host times
deferred_validation: same validation after all four CBs; complete output snapshots retained. No JSON or raw writes between four CBs in any phase.
scope: diagnostic only; controlled intervention, not an exact replay of old observer; no frequency/cache attribution without counters
correctness: initial three scorers and actual TopK pass; all468 outputs full compare to same-provider immutable reference, all guards and input postbytes exact
numeric_failure: preserve all visible raw and stop; no performance interpretation

decision_rule.next_stage: Only when numerical+sham+predecessor diagnostic rule supports a measurement correction, freeze a separate balanced-conditioning real component cohort, preserving >2% savings and <=2% abs drift gates for all3layers x2controls. No candidate math/source changes.
decision_rule.balanced_stability_formula: abs(100*(median(A2)/median(A1)-1))<=0.5 in balanced_tiled_inline; B is a different provider
decision_rule.within_round_conditioning_formula: Each formal round r:abs(100*(A2_r/A1_r-1)_legacy_tiled_inline)-abs(100*(A2_r/A1_r-1)_balanced_tiled_inline). Median reduction>=0.5 pp and strictly-positive reductions>=10/12.

limitations: Deterministic six forward/six reverse formal phase blocks balance first-order phase order; this is not randomized and does not erase all prior-resource/device history.
A conditioner intervention changes preceding GPU work plus its CPU observation; it cannot uniquely isolate hardware frequency, cache state, or a single microarchitectural mechanism.
The diagnostic does not yield adoption eligibility even when measurement-correction support gates pass.
revision_reason_before_any_diagnostic_GP: Independent review found cyclic rotation placed legacy before balanced in11/12 formal rounds. Replace with six forward/six reverse blocks before data collection; decision thresholds and samples unchanged.
